page.overview:
What is Raw Cod?

Raw cod is a food item that can be eaten by the player or cooked to make cooked cod.

Cod always drops 1 raw cod when killed, unaffected by Looting. If it is killed while on fire, it drops 1 cooked cod instead.

When killed, dolphins drop 0–1 raw cod. The maximum amount is increased by 1 per level of Looting, for a maximum of 0-4 with Looting III. If killed while on fire, they drop cooked cod instead.

Guardians and elder guardians have a 40% and 50% chance, respectively, to drop raw cod when killed. , cooked cod is dropped if a guardian is on fire when killed.
